description: She wears a muted blue-green patterned floor-length gown with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, edged with gold geometric and cloud-patterned borders. A decorated blue sash has a round metal clasp and hanging ornaments with tassels. An ivory wrap with blue-and-gold edging rests around her forearms; a light underlayer is visible through the low walking opening. Tall brown decorated boots are visible beneath the hem, and her head is bare.
